_description: Zalcano (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zalcano, /Strategies, Rock_Formation, Tephra, Refined_tephra, Imbued_tephra, Golem_(Zalcano), Demonic_Symbol, Zalcano_shard, Smolcano). Names are cache gamevals; tiles are the Wiki's and the map's. Values under a `_calibrated` note have no Wiki figure and are estimates.

prison._bounds: the room behind the barrier (map square 47,94)
prison._rocks: the map's own rock formations (south-west corners of the 3x3 locs); the Wiki lists them a tile further north-east
prison._firstRockWeights: north-west, north-east, south-west, south-east: the Wiki has north-east likeliest; the weights themselves are estimates

tephra._calibrated: the Wiki gives no tephra mining rate: the chance per attempt at a glowing rock and an ordinary one, and the extra ore a glowing rock can give

mining._maxHit: by Mining level, plus max((pickaxe level - 40) / 15, 0)

attacks._calibrated: the Wiki gives no intervals: how often she attacks, how often the glowing rock moves, how many boulders fall, how long symbols last and how fast the golem walks

rewards._points: main points: health + 2 x shield damage; tertiary points: min(health, 400) + 2 x min(shield, 300)
rewards._calibrated: the Wiki doesn't give how quantities scale with points: they run linearly from the table's minimum to its maximum at fullPoints

messages._unverified: the Wiki gives none of these, except the pet's (Pets.plugin.js)
messages.needQuest: You need to have completed Song of the Elves to enter Zalcano's prison.
messages.peek: You peek through the barrier. There {verb} {players} inside.
messages.noPickaxe: You need a pickaxe to mine this.
messages.noTephra: You have no tephra to refine.
messages.noRefined: You have no refined tephra to imbue.
messages.noImbued: You need imbued tephra to attack Zalcano.
messages.mineHer: Zalcano has fallen: mine her with a pickaxe.
messages.invulnerable: Zalcano can only be harmed with imbued tephra.
messages.fallen: Zalcano has fallen! Mine her while she's down.
messages.rises: Zalcano rises and the tephra crumbles away.
messages.tooLittle: You didn't contribute enough to receive a reward.
